syllabus.Nursery: English Phonics (A-Z), Rhymes, Counting (1-50), Colors & Shapes, Hindi Swar (अ-अः), Drawing & Good Habits.
syllabus.LKG: Alphabet Writing (A-Z, अ-ज्ञ), Number Counting (1-100), Picture Reading, Hindi/English Rhymes & Art.
syllabus.UKG: Three-letter Words, Simple Sentences, Addition & Subtraction, Environmental Awareness (EVS) & Spoken English.
syllabus.Class 1st: NCERT English Reader & Grammar, Hindi Vyakaran, Mathematics, EVS, Computer Basics & General Knowledge.
syllabus.Class 2nd: Sentence Building, Multiplication Tables (2 to 12), Hindi Stories, EVS Projects, Computer Paint & Moral Science.
syllabus.Class 3rd: NCERT English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science/EVS, Computer Typing, Moral Values & Basic Olympiad Prep.
syllabus.Class 4th: Advanced Primary Maths, English Grammar & Composition, EVS/Science Experiments, Computer Lab & Navodaya/Olympiad Prep.
syllabus.Class 5th: NCERT Curriculum for Class 5th (Maths, Science/EVS, English, Hindi & Social Studies).
syllabus.Class 6th: NCERT Curriculum for Class 6th (Maths, Science/EVS, English, Hindi & Social Studies).
syllabus.Class 7th: NCERT Curriculum for Class 7th (Maths, Science/EVS, English, Hindi & Social Studies).
syllabus.Class 8th: NCERT Curriculum for Class 8th (Maths, Science/EVS, English, Hindi & Social Studies).

homework.Nursery: Trace letters A to D in workbook & learn 'Twinkle Twinkle' poem.
homework.LKG: Write अ से ई तक and count numbers 1 to 30.
homework.UKG: Write 5 three-letter words and solve page 12 Maths addition.
homework.Class 1st: Read English Lesson 2 and learn Table of 2 & 3.
homework.Class 2nd: Learn Hindi Lesson 3 Q&A and solve 5 subtraction sums.
homework.Class 3rd: Draw parts of a plant in EVS notebook.
homework.Class 4th: Solve Fractions worksheet and revise Computer shortcut keys.
homework.Class 5th: Complete daily classwork & revise chapter exercises for Class 5th.
homework.Class 6th: Complete daily classwork & revise chapter exercises for Class 6th.
homework.Class 7th: Complete daily classwork & revise chapter exercises for Class 7th.
homework.Class 8th: Complete daily classwork & revise chapter exercises for Class 8th.
